text_en: You were with Brigard on the day we met in the desert, weren't you?
Soldiers of Zarga... I've always detested the way you act.
Your little speeches about justice and peace...
You think you're all above everyone else, without realising that you're nothing more than pawns following orders, just like any other soldier.
Even here you still go by what you think is fair, without asking yourselves if maybe you deserved to end up this way.
I, however, will always go by what I want to do. You're no better than me...
I was hoping to find Brigard, but I suppose a trusted soldier of his will do while he's on his way.
How is this possible? How do you have so much power?
Have you really exploited this world that much?
If you're not going to finish me, go. I don't need your pity.
